question: Who has been appointed as the Chairman and Managing Director of the India Trade Promotion Organization in October 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pradeep Singh Kharola.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pradeep Singh Kharola** has been appointed as the **Chairman and Managing Directo**r of the** India Trade Promotion Organization** in **October 2022.**
 
• India Trade Promotion Organization (ITPO) is a government agency established in** 1977 **under the **Ministry of Commerce and Industry.**
 
• Its main objective is to promote** India's trade and investment r**elations with other countries.
 
• The organization is responsible for organizing** trade fairs, exhibitions,** and other promotional events both in India and abroad to showcase India's products and services.
 
• The ITPO operates from its headquarters in** New Delhi** and has regional offices in Mumbai, Kolkata, Chennai, and Bengaluru.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• With effect from **November 1, 2023, Vibhu Nayar** has been appointed **OSD** in the **Ministry of Tribal Affairs**, with the rank of **Secretary.**
 
• **Rahul Narwekar **is a **politician from India **who is affiliated with the BJP.
 
 
• He now serves as the **Maharashtra Legislative Assembly's speaker.**
 
 
 
• The incoming **Indian ambassador to the Republic of Lebanon **is **Mohd. Noor Rahman Sheikh,** who serves as **Joint Secretary** in the Ministry of External Affairs.
